title: ULTRA HIKE Liechtenstein
description:
Long-distance hike in the Principality of Liechtenstein: 12-hour and 24-hour hike through the mountains of Liechtenstein

Welcome to the big 12h and 24h hike in the Principality of Liechtenstein! This unique tour starts at the heliport in the municipality of Balzers. The finish is on the outskirts of the main town of Vaduz at the stadium.
The varied route of the Ultra Hike Liechtenstein takes you through an impressive mountain world: from picturesque valleys to panoramic mountain trails to alpine peak panoramas. On your way you will experience a unique mix of nature, culture and sporting challenges - exactly what makes this hike so special.
The 12-hour hike is aimed at beginners and recreational hikers, while the 24-hour variant represents a challenge for well-trained amateur athletes. The adventurereich team provides drinks and food along the way to ensure that all participants reach their destination refreshed and safe. No matter whether you want to test your limits or just enjoy nature - this event offers the right challenge for everyone!
All information: https://www.erlebnisreich.de/tour/ultra-hike-liechtenstein-12-24h-wandel/

title: “Social Networks” exhibition by Flo Büchel
description:
The young Balzner Flo Büchel studies communication design at the Hamburg University of Applied Sciences and specializes in typography, 3D modeling and creative coding.

She received a scholarship for a three-month stay in the Liechtenstein artist studio in Berlin. During her stay, Flo Büchel explored the big city in the spring of 2026 in search of examples of analog networks. She was involved in events, led workshops in youth centers and experienced how people in Berlin live solidarity in everyday life. From their observations and conversations, a new understanding of communities in which people network and actively shape their environment developed.

The exhibition “Social Networks” invites you to discover the works created during your studio stay in Berlin, to take on new perspectives and to think together about how human connection can also arise beyond digital networks.

Friday, August 28th, from 6 p.m
Vernissage
Welcome: Markus Burgmeier, head of the old rectory
Introduction: Sonja Näscher, Office for Culture, Cultural Creation Department
Presentation by Flo Büchel: Background to the work (7 p.m.)
Conclusion: Techno DJ set with Flo Büchel (from 9 p.m.)

Exhibition opening times:
Fridays: 4-7 p.m
Saturdays and Sundays: 2 p.m. – 6 p.m

title: Informed pregnant in Liechtenstein
location: LAK-Haus St. MartinDr. A. SchÃ¤dler-Str. 119492 Eschen, Balzers
description:
At our free Informed Pregnant Evenings you will receive useful information about pregnancy and birth. Our experts provide information about your rights at work, financial questions, how to find a midwife or a birth preparation course and much more. You can just go, alone, with your partner or with someone you trust. No registration is necessary.

Topics of the evening in Liechtenstein:

• The rights of pregnant women in the workplace
Maternity leave, wage entitlement, protection against dismissal, health protection, parental leave

• Financial matters relating to pregnancy and birth
Birth allowance, maternity allowance, child allowances, single parent allowance, rental contributions, economic social assistance, premium reduction, maternity daily allowance

• How midwives support women
Support during pregnancy, birth, postpartum period and breastfeeding, confidant and supporter, entitlement to midwifery services, costs and financing

• Advice for mothers and fathers
Personal advice and support in the care, development and upbringing of your child

title: Village square concert series "Cat in a Sack - Moseg...
description:
Saturday, September 12, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m

“Cat in a poke” - Moses and more…

The popular format “Cat in a Sack” – Moseg and meh will take place for the last time this year on September 12th. As usual, it will only be announced a few days before who will surprise us musically and culinary. So much for the music, it's a Balzner combo that calls itself "Kapelle" and grooves like a band. As always, the Granville Café will be there with a variety of coffee delicacies and exotic drinks, as well as Martin Telser with his fine ice creams.

The event only takes place in good weather.
